title: Realized Scheduled Macro Shock Alignment and Later Native Lifecycle Economics

macro_program.name: external_market_event
macro_program.reason: The state begins with a scheduled external release and a realized cross-index market shock known before the included native birth. It is not an execution or broker-safety intervention.

research_height.transfer_path: official release -> completed fifteen-minute three-index shock -> later native entry-direction alignment -> full-lifecycle stressed-R and stop burden -> whether one future whole-portfolio event-state treatment question is worth opening

central_question: After official CPI or Employment Situation releases, does the realized first-fifteen-minute US30/US100/US500 shock create a materially and broadly different full-lifecycle value and stop state for later current-portfolio births aligned with that shock versus opposed to it?

lenses: mechanism: require a finite non-neutral median three-index release shock and report whether it is unanimous 3-of-3 or majority 2-of-3
transmission: compare ALIGNED versus OPPOSED component-period-centered stressed return on planned risk and stop incidence for births strictly after shock completion
portfolio result and falsification: require both books, event classes, temporal breadth, dense components, unanimous-shock replication and same-release mixed-direction contrast
research_bundle.common_boundary: Only official CPI and Employment releases, exact release through plus-fifteen-minute M5 opens, births strictly after plus fifteen and before plus 120 minutes, and the frozen complete fixed-0.01 CP2 lifecycle population are allowed.

why_now.current_bottleneck: The current portfolio still lacks a pre-birth scheduled-event state that can distinguish which already-generated entries deserve a later admission or priority counterfactual. Calendar occurrence alone did not identify adverse economics, and the P4 decision-regime unit closed invalid before any channel verdict.
connection_bridge: Unit 041 found POST_ENTRY_120M full-lifecycle residual R positive but stop residual +0.05135 and explicitly could not observe an event-time market mechanism.
Unit 058 could not answer the candidate-funnel regime because its frozen FOMC zero-row integrity anchor was false; no CPI or Employment decision residual became authoritative.

The official 96 CPI and Employment timestamps and 2,233 complete lifecycles are already authoritative, while exact event-window M5 prices have never been acquired or used in a valid portfolio-lifecycle question.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_recent: Units 085-086 were Program 1 completed-day signal supply and Program 3 post-native-window late-session independent-entry discovery. Unit 087 moves to Program 2, anchors causal time at a scheduled release, introduces exact event-window M5 market response, and evaluates existing native lifecycle selection rather than inventing a late-session entry.
why_now.decision_if_aligned_is_better: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future full-portfolio real-tick question testing whether admission or priority should favor shock-aligned native entries during the fixed post-release state.
why_now.decision_if_opposed_is_better: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future full-portfolio real-tick question testing whether admission or priority should favor shock-opposed native entries during the fixed post-release state.
why_now.decision_if_no_field_ambiguous_or_invali: Preserve unconditional behavior, retain no event-state treatment seed and rotate away without a shock-window, threshold, class, symbol, component or period rescue.

closed_boundary_distinction.unit_041: This is not an automatic direction or window rescue from Unit 041. Unit 041 used calendar occurrence only and had no realized event-time market path. Unit 087 is separately selected after a whole-map and data-role audit, acquires a new exact M5 role, excludes simultaneous plus-fifteen-minute births, and can change a different future decision: direction-conditional admission or priority rather than generic event suppression. No Unit 041 comparator or adverse-role gate is reused.
closed_boundary_distinction.unit_058: This is not a repair or rerun of Unit 058. It does not use the P4 candidate ledger, FOMC, PRE_120M, existing-exposure gate, aggregate risk heat or the false zero-row anchor. It uses all four periods and complete admitted lifecycles only after a new market shock is known.
closed_boundary_distinction.unit_084: Unit 084 rejected generic prior-direction consensus because each strategy selected a different prior clock and component cells were structurally confounded. Unit 087 assigns one common release shock to every subsequent birth from that event, centers outcomes by component-period, and requires dense component, both-book and within-event mixed-direction breadth. It uses no volume score or participation threshold.
closed_boundary_distinction.unit_086: Unit 086 created a new 19:00 entry on signal-deficit days and failed P1. Unit 087 neither consumes the Unit 085 seed nor changes a late-session clock, target book, horizon or residual threshold; it conditions actual current births after a scheduled release.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Unit 085's only independent-signal seed was consumed by Unit 086, and another signal transform or deficit-day subgroup would be adjacent.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: Selected because exact M5 realized release response is a new outcome-independent state role that calendar occurrence, rates, VIX, dispersion, drift and H1 participation did not contain.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Priority, occupancy, handoff and latency roles are closed; any priority implication remains a future full-portfolio treatment only if this market-state screen passes.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Profit-memory, peer-exit and path-management ideas still need naturally causal checkpoints and are not reopened through retrospective thresholds.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Lot, slot, turnover, removal and capital interventions lack a new complete binding counterfactual. Unit 087 reaches macro decision value only through a later whole-portfolio treatment question and makes no allocation claim itself.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Another closure-only synthesis would not change a portfolio decision; the new M5 role is directly acquired and bounded instead.
whole_map_recomparison.selection_judgment: The prior no-successor marker was correct for the roles then compared. The subsequent user-directed autonomous evidence-role audit found one materially new acquisition role with both a current portfolio bridge and perspective distance; no discarded external card is restored.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and micro, meso and macro. Do not automatically open the retained treatment seed or any event/shock neighbor.

target: The 48 CPI and 48 Employment Situation rows in the frozen official calendar, converted from Eastern Time to the frozen FPMarkets server clock.
US30, US100 and US500 M5 bars at release, plus 5, plus 10 and plus 15 minutes, acquired in one isolated Lab runtime.
Current native lifecycles born strictly after release plus 15 minutes and strictly before release plus 120 minutes across P1, P2, P3 and P4.
ALIGNED and OPPOSED states, all represented books and components, component-period-centered stressed R, and component-period-centered stop incidence.
excluded: FOMC, unscheduled events, PPI, JOLTS, retail sales, speeches, minutes, press conferences and event-day proxies
released value, consensus, surprise, revision, policy text or news content
shock magnitude threshold, volatility scaling, dispersion, correlation, beta, volume, spread, alternative symbol basket or tradable US500 leg
births at or before plus fifteen minutes, a shorter or longer birth window, alternate shock horizon, event subset, month, weekday, component, direction or best-period rescue
new signal, suppression rule, admission, priority, preemption, exit, lot, slot, risk, MQL, compile, Tester, Program 6 or Live change
automatic_followups_forbidden: single event class, symbol, book, component, period or direction
event filter, admission, priority, preemption, allocation, lot, slot, risk, exit, EA or Live implementation

frozen_lifecycle_rows.unused_fields: Unit 084 participation regime and every volume score are ignored.

calendar_and_shock_contract.timezone: Parse official release wall time in Windows Eastern Standard Time, convert to UTC, then to Windows FLE Standard Time for the frozen FPMarkets server clock. DST mismatch weeks are preserved.
calendar_and_shock_contract.shock_prices: For each symbol use the M5 bar open at exact release server time and the M5 bar open at exact release plus fifteen minutes.
calendar_and_shock_contract.symbol_return: Natural logarithm of plus-fifteen-minute open divided by release open.
calendar_and_shock_contract.shock_direction: LONG when the median of the three symbol returns is strictly positive; SHORT when strictly negative. A zero median makes the unit invalid rather than opening a tie rule.
calendar_and_shock_contract.shock_breadth: UNANIMOUS_3_OF_3 when all three nonzero return signs equal the median sign; otherwise MAJORITY_2_OF_3. No magnitude threshold is used.
calendar_and_shock_contract.simultaneous_boundary: The lower endpoint is strict. Five structurally identified births exactly at plus fifteen minutes are excluded because the shock-ending price is not earlier than those decisions.
calendar_and_shock_contract.role: ALIGNED when native birth direction equals shock direction; OPPOSED otherwise.
calendar_and_shock_contract.assignment: A birth may match at most one release. Any overlap is invalid.

acquisition_contract.copy_rule: One physical minimal 17-file copy from the neutral Lab runtime. No source, executable, settings, state, log or runtime dependency on another family or Live.
acquisition_contract.retained_rows: Exactly the four M5 bars at offsets 0, 5, 10 and 15 minutes for each of 96 events and each of three symbols; full requested history is not retained as project evidence.
acquisition_contract.forbidden_api_calls: account_info, positions_get, orders_get, history_orders_get, history_deals_get, order_check, order_send and every trade or broker-state call
acquisition_contract.acquisition_boundary: Bar rows and symbol specs are frozen and pushed before any three-index shock return, role assignment or conditional lifecycle metric is calculated.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Official-time conversion and birth event, timestamp, component and direction only. No event-window M5 price, shock sign or magnitude, lifecycle close value, stopped flag, centered outcome, conditional effect, gate or verdict was accessed.
pre_outcome_feasibility.predeclaration_tooling_disclosure: Two malformed read-only PowerShell precheck attempts stopped before usable classification and emitted no event-window market or conditional lifecycle metric. Corrected outcome-free topology produced the frozen counts above.

fixed_reconstruction.direction: For OPEN, LONG when logged stop is below value_a entry and SHORT when above. For Passive, carry the active PASSIVE_PLACE direction into PASSIVE_FILL; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle_join: Join each of exactly 2,233 reconstructed births one-to-one to the frozen lifecycle row by period, component and exact birth_time. Require exact planned risk agreement and zero duplicate or unmatched keys.
fixed_reconstruction.outcomes: Use the frozen lifecycle row's stressed_r, stop, centered_stressed_r and centered_stop. Centering is the lifecycle value minus the complete same-component same-period mean across all 2,233 rows.
fixed_reconstruction.primary_contrast: Equal-lifecycle mean centered outcome in ALIGNED minus equal-lifecycle mean centered outcome in OPPOSED.
fixed_reconstruction.period_class_component_book_views: Repeat the same ALIGNED-minus-OPPOSED contrast within every eligible fixed view; do not reweight or fit a model.
fixed_reconstruction.unanimous_view: Repeat the pooled contrast using only UNANIMOUS_3_OF_3 events.
fixed_reconstruction.same_release_view: For each of the twelve preidentified events containing both native directions, subtract OPPOSED mean centered outcome from ALIGNED mean centered outcome within that event, then average the twelve event contrasts with equal event weight.

fixed_integrity_gate: Every immutable tracked input retains its declared byte length and SHA-256 hash.
The official calendar retains 128 rows and exact CPI/Employment counts 48/48; conversion yields 96 unique in-scope release times.
The acquisition returns exact finite positive OHLC and strictly increasing epoch rows with nonnegative volume and spread for all fifteen annual symbol calls.
The retained event-window export contains exactly 1,152 unique rows: 96 events times three symbols times four offsets 0/5/10/15, with no missing or extra event-symbol-offset key.
Every release and plus-fifteen open is finite and positive; every three-symbol median return is finite and nonzero.

Reconstruct exactly 2,233 births and exact strict-window topology 126 births across 81 events, four periods, 64 CPI, 62 Employment, 65 LONG and 61 SHORT, excluding exactly five simultaneous plus-fifteen births.
Join all 2,233 births one-to-one to the frozen lifecycle rows with zero duplicate, unmatched, planned-risk or centered-outcome fault.
No birth matches more than one event and every conditional metric is finite.

requirements: ALIGNED and OPPOSED each contain at least 40 births.
Each role appears at least five times in every period and at least fifteen times in each event class.
Each role contains at least five US30-book and twenty US100-book births.
Cross and Passive each contain at least ten births per role; Return contains at least five per role. Pressure is reported but excluded from component-breadth voting because its frozen count is one.
All twelve preidentified mixed-native-direction events contain both roles after shock assignment.
UNANIMOUS_3_OF_3 events contribute at least 40 births total and at least fifteen births per role.
No one period or eligible component contributes more than 60 percent of either role.
fixed_density_gate_before_lifecycle_outc.failure: If any requirement fails, close INVALID_REALIZED_MACRO_SHOCK_ALIGNMENT_DENSITY_NO_VERDICT before reading conditional lifecycle outcomes.

aligned_favorable: Pooled ALIGNED-minus-OPPOSED centered stressed_r is at least +0.10R.
Pooled ALIGNED-minus-OPPOSED centered stop incidence is at most -0.05.
Both event classes and both books have positive stressed-R contrasts and nonpositive stop contrasts; each event class reaches at least +0.05R and at most -0.025 stop.
At least three of four periods have positive stressed-R and nonpositive stop contrasts.
At least two of Cross, Passive and Return have positive stressed-R and nonpositive stop contrasts.
The UNANIMOUS_3_OF_3 contrast is at least +0.05R and at most -0.025 stop.
The equal-event same-release contrast is at least +0.05R and at most -0.025 stop.
opposed_favorable: Pooled ALIGNED-minus-OPPOSED centered stressed_r is at most -0.10R.
Pooled ALIGNED-minus-OPPOSED centered stop incidence is at least +0.05.
Both event classes and both books have negative stressed-R contrasts and nonnegative stop contrasts; each event class reaches at most -0.05R and at least +0.025 stop.
At least three of four periods have negative stressed-R and nonnegative stop contrasts.
At least two of Cross, Passive and Return have negative stressed-R and nonnegative stop contrasts.
The UNANIMOUS_3_OF_3 contrast is at most -0.05R and at least +0.025 stop.
The equal-event same-release contrast is at most -0.05R and at least +0.025 stop.

requirements: Absolute pooled centered stressed-R contrast is less than 0.05R.
Absolute pooled centered stop-incidence contrast is less than 0.025.
Neither directional pattern appears jointly in more than two periods or more than one eligible component.

fixed_verdict_rules.aligned_favorable: PASS_REALIZED_MACRO_SHOCK_ALIGNED_STATE_RETAIN_ONE_TREATMENT_QUESTION when integrity, density and every aligned-favorable gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.opposed_favorable: PASS_REALIZED_MACRO_SHOCK_OPPOSED_STATE_RETAIN_ONE_TREATMENT_QUESTION when integrity, density and every opposed-favorable gate pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_field: NO_MATERIAL_REALIZED_MACRO_SHOCK_ALIGNMENT_FIELD when integrity and density pass and the complete strong-null rule triggers.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_REALIZED_MACRO_SHOCK_ALIGNMENT_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity and density pass but no preceding economic verdict applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_REALIZED_MACRO_SHOCK_ALIGNMENT_NO_VERDICT when any input, acquisition, shock, reconstruction, join or density requirement fails.

decision_translation.passing_state: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic future full-portfolio real-tick admission-or-priority treatment question for the selected fixed state. No treatment implementation opens in Unit 087.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Preserve unconditional behavior, retain no seed and rotate away.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away without same-family repair after the allowed premetric correction is exhausted.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration and the single Frontier memory before creating the runtime or acquiring M5 bars.
Commit and push the event-window bars, symbol specs and acquisition receipt before calculating shock returns, assigning roles or reading conditional lifecycle outcomes.
One implementation-only correction is allowed only before any conditional lifecycle metric is emitted. After any new metric, make no correction or rerun.
Do not alter the event classes, shock horizon, symbols, lower or upper birth boundary, state definition, outcomes, thresholds, breadth, verdict or decision after results.
Do not create MQL, compile, run Tester, query broker/account/position/order/deal state, touch Live or open Program 6.
Close and freeze the family after the one fixed aggregation, then recompare the whole map before any successor.
